meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文案、网页或设计稿做成动画视频并渲染导出
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把网页、设计稿或文案快速变成宣传片、解说视频或动效片段。
copy.tagline_en: Turn copy, web pages, or design files into rendered animated videos.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn a web page, design file, or brief into a promo, explainer, or motion video.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 接到做视频、动画或动态图形的请求会先读此技能:它会确认项目状态与素材类型,撰写 BRIEF.md 并选定对应工作流,再从 HTML 渲染出视频,默认以 HyperFrames 为输出框架。
howto.when: 当你要求制作、修改或渲染视频、动画、动态图形(如宣传片、讲解片、字幕剪辑等),或要检查、预览、发布已有的 HyperFrames 项目时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个网址做成一段宣传视频
say.note: 会先问视频主题,再选工作流

say.text: 给这段口播素材加字幕,画面别改动
把这个 Remotion 项目迁移到 HyperFrames

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads this skill first on any video, animation, or motion-graphics request: it checks project state and inputs, writes BRIEF.md, picks the owning workflow, then renders video from HTML — HyperFrames is the default framework.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to make, edit, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic (promo, explainer, captioned clip, etc.), or to inspect, preview, or publish an existing HyperFrames project.

say_en.text: Turn this website into a promo video
say_en.note: Asks about the subject before routing
